messages:
Maya P: Heads-up — HW partner (Nimbus) wants a coordinated private-offer + appliance migration announcement. They want a sandbox for SI bundles and a clear SKU floor. Can we sync cadence?
Sam R: +1. Do we have target dates from Nimbus?
Maya P: They proposed April 15 for joint press, but internal engineering needs 2 weeks to validate the market SKU mapping.
Leo C: We should lock the commit floor first. Suggest $250k minimum for the private-offer bundle, with a 3-tranche renewal ramp.
Kaitlyn: $250k sounds ok. We need to decide discount tiers: 18% @250k, 25% @500k, 32% @1M? Also define onboard credits for SIs (timeboxed).
Oliver T: Agree on tiered discounts. From ops POV we need SKU-level mapping to pricing matrix. I'll create a mapping sheet. Link: https://docs.google.com/sheet/example (internal)
Maya P: Perfect. Also legal asked for a renewal opt-in window and clear usage floor wording. Legal-team — what phrasing do you need?
legal-team: Need explicit consumption def (monthly invoiceable units), renewal opt-in = 60 days before term end, and clause for SKU sunset (30-day notice). We'll draft a private-offer template.
Sam R: For Dedicated customers, we should allow a hardware-kicker credit (one-time) vs spread over 12 months. Which do we prefer?
Kaitlyn: Hardware-kicker as a credit applied to first invoice is simpler for accounting.
Leo C: Ops note: if we apply big credits upfront it skews MRR metrics. Recommend amortize over 12 months in billing, show one-time rebate on desk.
Maya P: Good point — product and finance need alignment. Sam, can you coordinate with finance on treatment?
Sam R: On it. Will ping @finance.
marketplace-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Nimbus partner announce sync" — Wed Apr 3 10:00am PT. Invite sent to Maya, Sam, Leo, Kaitlyn, Oliver, Nimbus PM.
Oliver T: Two engineering asks: 1) Marketplace private-offer flow must support multi-SKU bundles and per-SKU usage reporting; 2) SI onboarding credits must be redeemable via token. Any constraints?
Leo C: We support multi-SKU offers but need to confirm telemetry keys for per-SKU usage. I'll get infra to add tags.
Kaitlyn: I'll draft the SI credit redemption page copy and requirements.
Maya P: Decision items for the Apr 3 sync: final commit floor, discount bands, SI credit amount + redemption flow, announcement timeline + embargo, renewal opt-in terms, billing treatment of HW credits.
Sam R: I'll own commit floor + pricing bands. Kaitlyn owns SI credit UX. Leo owns infra tagging. Maya will own partner comms and embargo. Oliver to own release notes + marketplace feature flags.
Maya P: Quick check — are customers eligible for early renewal incentives? Nimbus asked for a 90-day early-renew bonus (extra 5% credit). Thoughts?
Leo C: Operationally doable but increases accounting churn. Maybe offer a capped credit and require pre-pay.
Kaitlyn: Could be included as a time-limited promo for first 6 months after launch. We can track via promo code redemption.
Sam R: Fine with capped 5% if pre-pay required. Add to decision doc.
Maya P: Cool. I'll assemble a short decision doc and drop in this thread before the meeting. Expect: pricing matrix, sample PO language, and launch checklist.
Oliver T: FYI — filing an internal bug for marketplace UX edge-case with multi-SKU private offers: #3421.
marketplace-bot: Reminder — upload final pricing matrix to /shared/partners by Apr 1 or meeting will be for planning only.
Maya P: Thanks all — see you Apr 3. I put a quick agenda in the calendar invite: pricing decision, legal sign-off, infra tagging, promo mechanics, launch comms.
Sam R: :thumbsup:
Kaitlyn: Added SI onboarding flow draft to the sheet.
Leo C: Will follow up with infra ETA.
legal-team: Draft PO template uploaded to /legal/private-offers/nimbus-draft.docx
Maya P: End of thread."
